one_liner: Zoho CRM has a broad REST API (v8) with OAuth 2.0 auth-code flow, free plan/Developer Edition for self-serve credentials, and vendor-published MCP servers.
auth_notes: Authorization-code grant with connected app registered in Zoho API console; access tokens last 1 hour, refresh tokens unlimited until revoked. Source says OAuth 2.0 exclusively, no API-key option.
access_notes: Third-party review says API is included on all plans incl. permanent free plan (3 users, 5,000 credits/day), and a free Developer Edition exists. Not confirmed on vendor's own pages in this set, so access confidence is medium. The Zoho CRM homepage confirms a freemium edition for up to 3 users and a free trial.
blocker_notes: Minor: data-center-specific URLs, per-org tokens, credit-based rate limits; none are blockers.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the **OAuth 2.0** protocol for authentication.
Zoho CRM uses [OAuth 2.0](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/oauth-overview.html) exclusively for API authentication. There is no API-key option.
There is no separate developer signup, no enterprise gate, and no approval process.
Zoho also offers a [free Developer Edition](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/developer-edition.html), a full CRM instance for building and testing
Zoho CRM's freemium edition supports up to 3 users and comes with the essentials like leads, documents, and mobile apps
Zoho CRM's** API is a mature REST surface, now on its [eighth major version]
Zoho CRM provides these as pre-built MCP servers, so you don't need to build, host, or maintain any infrastructure.
When you invoke an MCP tool for the first time, the server initiates an OAuth flow.
